sections.title: **INVESTIGATION:     ULTRASOUND WHOLE ABDOMEN**
sections.text:
**_=======================================================_** 

**Liver:** is normal in size (~11.2cm), outline and **showing diffusely increased parenchymal echogenicity** . No focal lesion is seen. No intrahepatic biliary dilatation seen. Hepatic veins are normal. Portal vein is normal. 

**Gall bladder** : Well distended. No e/o any calculus / mass seen in its lumen. No e/o any GB wall thickening or pericholecystic collection. Proximal CBD is normal in caliber. 

**Pancreas:** is normal (head and body) in bulk and echogenicity, tail is obscured due to overlying bowel gases. MPD is not dilated. 

**Spleen:** is normal in size (~7cm), outline and echogenicity. No focal lesion seen. 

**Right kidney:** is normal in size (~10.5cm), shape and outline with normal cortical echogenicity. Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained. No calculus or hydronephrosis is seen. 

**Left kidney:** is normal in size (~10.3cm), shape and outline with normal cortical echogenicity. Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained. 

**Moderate hydrouretronephrosis is seen (Proximal ureter ~ 8 mm in SAD) however no obvious calculus is seen in PCS and visualized proximal ureter -?Distal uretric calculus.** 

**Urinary Bladder:** It is well distended and shows normal wall thickness. **Multiple moving echoes are seen in its lumen- ? UTI.** 

**Prostate:** It is normal in size (Vol~15cc), shape and echotexture. No lymphadenopathy / free fluid seen. <u>Bowel loops are normal in calibre.</u> 

**IMPRESSION:** 

- **Grade I fatty liver. (Adv: LFT & Lipid Profile).** 

- **Moderate left HDUN-? Distal ureteric calculus.** 

- **Multiple moving echoes in its lumen- ? UTI.** **<u>(Adv: NCCT-KUB, RFT & Urine R/E for further evaluation if clinically indicated).</u>** 

Please correlate clinically and with other relevant investigations.
